ic_device.name: TL431
ic_device.description: Three-terminal adjustable shunt regulator with output voltage adjustable from Vref to 36V.

pins.name: ANODE
pins.description: Common pin, normally connected to ground
pins.evidence: Common pin, normally connected to ground

port_dependencies.condition: Datasheet identifies ANODE as the common pin normally connected to ground; no settling time stated.
Closed-loop operation feeds the cathode/output voltage or current back to REF; no settling time stated.

functional_blocks.name: Adjustable shunt regulator
functional_blocks.description: Internal reference and amplifier control sink current at CATHODE; REF is the threshold input relative to ANODE.
